description: This file defines a syntax highlighting mode for Dockerfile scripts for the CodeMirror editor. It includes patterns for recognizing Dockerfile instructions, comments, and syntax structures, and registers the mode with CodeMirror for use in code editing environments.

methods.name: defineSimpleMode
methods.description: Defines a simple syntax highlighting mode for Dockerfile syntax.

methods.name: defineMIME
methods.description: Associates a MIME type with the Dockerfile syntax mode.
